summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) which adds write permission support to shared folders, allowing recipients to upload, edit, rename, and delete files in shared folders.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed and verified with UAT. Multiple critical bugs discovered and fixed during checkpoint verification: per-file IPNS record creation for shared uploads, dual-key IPNS wrapping for owner+recipient access, shared file save path in TextEditorDialog, and re-wrapping share keys when owner edits shared files.

repo: cipher-box-ci-debug is a separate checkout that requires .env files copied from the main cipher-box repo — env files are not committed and the IP address of the DB host changes (was 192.168.133.114, changed to 192.168.133.12)
The web app falls back to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL is not set, causing connection failures when API runs on a different port (3000) than web (5173)
@cipherbox/sdk and its dependency chain (core, sdk-core) must be built before the web dev server can start
NestJS watch mode does not always pick up DTO changes — @ApiProperty enum changes require a full API restart to appear in the OpenAPI spec
The api-client package must be regenerated after any DTO changes affecting the OpenAPI spec before TypeScript will compile cleanly
OTPs for login can be retrieved from the running API server logs
createFileMetadata() internally zeros the IPNS private key after use, so it cannot be called when you need to wrap the key for multiple parties — must inline the keypair generation
The owner's handleUpdateFile flow does not re-wrap the new file key for share recipients, meaning any owner edit breaks recipient decryption — pre-existing gap exposed by phase 27

code.finding: Shared upload previously set fileMetaIpnsName: '' and skipped creating per-file IPNS records, making uploaded files unreadable after upload
Error 'File metadata IPNS name not available (legacy v1 file?)' thrown when fileMetaIpnsName is empty — originally a legacy check but triggered for all shared uploads
TextEditorDialog save handler used owner's updateFile path (useFolder hook) for all saves, failing for shared files with 'Parent folder not found or vault not initialized'
API URL defaults to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL is not set — requires apps/web/.env with VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 for local dev
Permission downgrade clears encryptedIpnsKey but does not touch share_keys — file key share_keys remain valid after downgrade
handleUpdateFile does not re-wrap the new file key for existing share recipients after owner edits a file, breaking recipient decryption on next open
ShareKeyEntryDto keyType enum was constrained to 'file' | 'folder' — extended to 'file-ipns' to store recipient-wrapped IPNS private keys separately
ShareKey entity keyType enum needed updating alongside DTO and @ApiProperty to reflect in OpenAPI spec

workflow: Background bash tasks in Claude Code are killed when tool call context shifts — use detached processes (nohup or &disown) for dev servers that need to persist across conversation turns
NestJS OpenAPI spec requires both the entity enum AND @ApiProperty enum to be updated for changes to appear in generated clients
When createFileMetadata() internally destroys the IPNS private key, multi-party key wrapping requires inlining the keypair generation manually
Git lock files (.git/index.lock) can accumulate from killed background tasks and need manual removal before committing

friction: Dev servers repeatedly killed by Claude Code background task cleanup — required switching to detached processes
DB host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring manual .env creation
No .env files committed to cipher-box-ci-debug checkout — had to copy from sibling cipher-box directory
@cipherbox/sdk dependency chain (core → sdk-core → sdk) must be built in order before web server starts — not documented
NestJS watch mode did not pick up DTO changes, requiring full API restart and client regeneration to resolve TypeScript errors
Git lock file (.git/index.lock) blocked commits after background task kills
createFileMetadata() destroys IPNS private key internally, preventing dual-party wrapping without inlining its logic
Four separate UAT-discovered bugs required mid-checkpoint fixes before approval could be given
open_items: Files uploaded to shared folders before the IPNS fix (with empty fileMetaIpnsName) cannot be retroactively fixed — must be deleted and re-uploaded

The owner's handleUpdateFile does not re-wrap file keys for all share recipients generically — the fix added in this session covers the immediate case but a broader audit of owner file operations (rename, move) may be needed
Silent revocation (403 handling, [RW]→[RO] key zeroing, 30s polling) was listed as a human verification item but not confirmed tested by the user before session end
The 'file-ipns' share_key type was added as a PoC workaround — the share_keys table schema and API may benefit from a more formal key hierarchy design
Re-wrapping share keys on owner file edit currently fetches all share_keys and re-wraps synchronously — could be slow for files with many recipients
